acceptance_definition: All 8 profiles: DC envelope at independent 1% residual; all transitions at four envelope corners, 80 ns, three solver settings; nominal crosschecks
residual_definition: Independent relative error on all 6 effective positive path coefficients and absolute cancellation V/V coefficient; references/supply/MOS fixed per profile
envelope_assumptions: DC feed-forward monotone carry and sum transfer; positive paths, negative cancellation and nonnegative carry. Not a proof of all transient histories.
limits: Baseband proxy only, no new FDTD
No stochastic noise or drift in threshold/supply/offset during frozen operation
Residual corners do not exhaust all dynamic coefficient corners or histories
Local Vdd only; ideal trim/sensing/switching/inputs excluded
80 ns training dwell assumed; host calculation time is not hardware latency
